records.jp: あ、日菜子ちゃん！^00迷ってたりなんかしない？　大丈夫？
records.en_original: Oh, Hinako! You didn't get lost or anything, did you? Are you okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Hinako! You didn't get lost or anything, did you? Are you okay?
records.en: Oh, Hinako-chan!^00You didn't get lost or anything, did you? Are you okay?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん、学校には慣れてきた？^00えへへ……。^00日菜子ちゃんと一緒の学校……楽しいなぁ
records.en_original: Are you used to this school yet, Hinako? Eheheh... Being your classmate...is pretty exciting.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you used to this school yet, Hinako? Eheheh, being your classmate is...pretty exciting.
records.en: Are you used to this school yet, Hinako-chan?^00Eheheh...^00Being your classmate...is pretty exciting.

records.jp: 原種……。ずいぶん現実離れしてるけど……^00これもなんか、学生っぽいよね！^00え、それは違う！？　そっかぁ……
records.en_original: Fighting against the Sephirot sounds impossible. But I guess that's what students do... W-Wait, they don't? Hmm.
records.en_auxiliary: Fighting against the Sephira sounds impossible. But I guess that's what students do. W-wait, they don't? Hmm.
records.en: A Sephira... This all feels pretty unreal,^00but somehow it feels kind of student-like too!^00What, it doesn't!? Oh...

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん。文化祭、楽しみだね。^00せいいっぱい頑張って、^00一生の思い出にしようね！
records.en_original: The school festival sounds fun, right, Hinako? Let's make it a memorable event!
records.en_auxiliary: You're looking forward to the culture festival, right, Hinako? Let's make it a memorable event!
records.en: The culture festival's going to be fun, Hinako-chan.^00Let's give it everything we've got^00and make a memory that'll last a lifetime!

records.jp: やっぱり日菜子ちゃんはすごいよねぇ。^00みんなの悩み事、どんどん解決してて。^00わたし、憧れちゃうよ……
records.en_original: Hinako, you're really great. You listen to everyone and solve their problems... I want to be like you.
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, you're really great. You listen to everyone and solve their problems. I want to be like you.
records.en: Hinako-chan, you're really great.^00You listen to everyone and solve their problems...^00I want to be like you.

records.jp: ごめんね、日菜子ちゃんの方がつらいのに。^00……私にできることなら何でも言ってね。^00頑張ってお手伝いしてみせるから！
records.en_original: Sorry, I'm sure you're suffering more than I am... Let me know if there's anything I can help you with.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, I'm sure you're suffering more than I am. Let me know if there's anything I can help you with.
records.en: Sorry, even though this must be harder for you, Hinako-chan.^00Tell me if there's anything I can do.^00I'll do my best to help!

records.jp: 記憶を無くしても……また日菜子ちゃんとも^00ユズちゃんとも、ライムちゃんとも^00お友達になってみせる！　絶対だよ！
records.en_original: Even if we lose our memories... I will make friends you again, Hinako. Yuzu and Lime, too! I promise!
records.en_auxiliary: Even if we lose our memories, I'll make friends with you again, Hinako. Yuzu and Lime, too! I promise!
records.en: Even if we lose our memories,^00I'll become friends with you again, Hinako-chan—^00and with Yuzu-chan and Lime-chan too! I promise!

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん、どう？^00私、今日も決まってる？
records.en_original: What do you think, Hinako? Do I look good today?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think, Hinako? Do I look good today?
records.en: What do you think, Hinako-chan?^00Do I look good today?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん、かわいいんだからさ～。^00もうちょっとオシャレしちゃいなよ。^00きっと男子にモテモテだよ？
records.en_original: You're so pretty, Hinako! You really should dress up a little bit. I'm sure you'd drive the boys crazy.
records.en_auxiliary: You're so pretty, Hinako! You really should dress up a little bit. I'm sure you'd drive the boys crazy.
records.en: You're so pretty, Hinako-chan!^00You really should dress up a little bit.^00I'm sure you'd drive the boys crazy.

records.jp: 文化祭……とくれば、^00気合いを入れないわけにはいかないよね！^00メイクもコーデも十倍増しで決めないと！
records.en_original: The school festival... A time to make ourselves even prettier! Our makeup and clothes have to be ten times better!
records.en_auxiliary: The culture festival... A time to make ourselves even prettier! Our makeup and clothes have to be ten times better!
records.en: The culture festival...^00We have to go all out!^00Our makeup and outfits should look ten times better!

records.jp: 決められないなら私が決めてあげる。^00日菜子ちゃん、原種を倒して。^00それが二人が望んでることだと思うから……
records.en_original: If you can't make a decision, then I will make one for you. Defeat the Sephira, Hinako. It's what they'd want.
records.en_auxiliary: If you can't make a decision, then I'll make one for you. Defeat the Sephira, Hinako. It's what they'd want.
records.en: If you can't make a decision, then I will make one for you.^00Defeat the Sephira, Hinako-chan.^00It's what they'd want.

records.jp: 二人のことバッチリかわいくしてあげるの。^00それが、私にできることだから！^00さぁ。日菜子ちゃんにできることは、何？
records.en_original: I'm going to make sure that Yuzu and Lime look pretty. That's what I can do for them! So, what can YOU do, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm going to make sure that Yuzu and Lime look pretty. That's what I can do for them! So, what can YOU do, Hinako?
records.en: I'm going to make sure that Yuzu and Lime look pretty.^00That's what I can do for them!^00So, what can YOU do, Hinako-chan?

records.jp: まとめサイトでも……ん？^00どうかしたの？
records.en_original: I'm going to browse the web... Huh? What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm going to browse the web. Huh? What's wrong?
records.en: I'm going to browse the web...^00Huh? What's wrong?

records.jp: 今はまってるゲーム、すごい面白いんだ。^00興味があれば、日菜子もやってみたら？
records.en_original: The video game I'm digging is really good. Why don't you try it if you're interested?
records.en_auxiliary: The video game I'm into right now is really good. Why don't you try it if you're interested?
records.en: The video game I'm digging is really good.^00Why don't you try it if you're interested?

records.jp: ふぅ。陸上……か。^00え、ううん。ゲームの話。^00だから、気にしないで
records.en_original: *sigh* Track and field... Huh? Oh, I'm just talking about a video game. Don't worry about me.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* Track and field... Huh? Oh, I'm just talking about a video game. Don't worry about me.
records.en: *sigh* Track and field... Huh?^00Oh, I'm just talking about a video game.^00Don't worry about me.

records.jp: このゲームの主役はあんただよ。^00大丈夫、なるようになるって
records.en_original: You are the main character in this  game. Don't worry, it'll be fine.
records.en_auxiliary: You're the main character in this game. Don't worry, it'll be fine.
records.en: You're the main character in this game.^00Don't worry. It'll work out.

records.jp: あたしから言えるのは１つだけ。^00……とにかく、後悔しないようにね
records.en_original: All I can tell you is...try to end it in a way you won't regret.
records.en_auxiliary: All I can tell you is...try to end it in a way you won't regret.
records.en: All I can tell you is...try to end^00it in a way you won't regret.

records.jp: もっと大きく育ちなさい……。^00え？　ああ。やみのどうくつで遊んでたの。^00今人気のフリスペ！のゲームなのよ？
records.en_original: Make my monsters grow.... What? Oh. I was just playing Dark Cave. It's a really popular FreeSpace game.
records.en_auxiliary: Grow, monsters, grow! What? Oh. I was just playing Dark Cave. It's a really popular FreeSpace game.
records.en: Make my monsters grow.... What? Oh.^00I was just playing Dark Cave.^00It's a really popular FreeSpace game.

records.jp: 今何をしてるのかって？^00チャットに返信してるのよ。^00フリスペ！には何でもあるんだから
records.en_original: What am I doing? Replying to chat <CR>messages. FreeSpace has everything.
records.en_auxiliary: What am I doing? Replying to chat <CR>messages. FreeSpace has everything.
records.en: What am I doing?^00Replying to chat messages.^00FreeSpace has everything.

records.jp: ふんふーん♪え、ああ。^00ジュークボックスで曲を聞いてたの。^00いろんな曲があって盛り上がるのよ？
records.en_original: La la la...♪ What? Oh. I was just listening to music on Jukebox. It's a good app with a lot of songs.
records.en_auxiliary: La la la...♪ What? Oh. I was just listening to music on Jukebox. It's a good app with a lot of songs.
records.en: La la la...♪ What? Oh.^00I was just listening to music on Jukebox.^00It's a good app with a lot of songs.

records.jp: ふむふむ、なるほど。^00今はフリスペ！で記事を読んでたの。^00みんなの投稿、個性があって面白いのよ
records.en_original: Hmm... I see. ....I was just reading an article on FreeSpace. People post all kinds of interesting stuff there.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm-hmm... I see. I'm just reading an article on FreeSpace! People post all kinds of interesting stuff there.
records.en: Hmm... I see.^00....I was just reading an article on FreeSpace.^00People post all kinds of interesting stuff there.

records.jp: どの部活に入るか悩んでるうちに、^00もうこんな時期に……。料理に吹奏楽、^00手芸にテニス……うー、決められなーいー！
records.en_original: I was so indecisive about which club to join, they all started without me! Cooking, brass band, crafts, tennis...?
records.en_auxiliary: I was so indecisive about which club to join, they all started without me! Cooking, brass band, crafts, tennis... Ugh, I can't decide!
records.en: I spent so long trying to choose a club^00that it's already this time of year... Cooking, brass band,^00crafts, tennis... Ugh, I can't decide!

records.jp: 料理部と手芸部、体験入部してみたの。^00料理部ではお皿を割り、^00手芸部では生地ごとはさみで手を切り……
records.en_original: I paid trial visits to the cooking club and crafts club. Broke a dish in the former, I cut my hand in the latter...
records.en_auxiliary: I paid trial visits to the cooking club and crafts club. Broke a dish in the former, cut my hand in the latter...
records.en: I tried the cooking club and crafts club.^00I broke a plate in cooking,^00and cut my hand with the scissors in crafts...

records.jp: 私たぶん、どっちも向いてないわ……。^00他の部活、考えよ……
records.en_original: I don't see myself doing well in either of those. I'll think of something else...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't see myself doing well in either of those. I'll think of something else.
records.en: I don't see myself doing well in either of those.^00I'll think of something else...

records.jp: こないだテニス部に体験入部したの。^00でも、練習がきつすぎて……。^00運動部は厳しそうね……
records.en_original: I gave the tennis club a try the other day, but the training was so hard... Which rules out sports altogether...
records.en_auxiliary: I gave the tennis club a try the other day, but the training was so hard... Which rules out sports altogether.
records.en: I gave the tennis club a try the other day,^00but the training was so hard...^00Which rules out sports altogether...

records.jp: 私、部活決めたわ。吹奏楽部にする！^00え、決め手は何かって？
records.en_original: Okay, I've made up my mind. I'll join the brass band! Why?
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, I've made up my mind. I'll join the brass band! Why, you ask?
records.en: Okay, I've made up my mind.^00I'll join the brass band! Why?

records.jp: 先輩にかっこいい人がいたのー！^00私、あの人みたいになりたくて！　きゃー！
records.en_original: Because there was this really, really cool upperclassman in there. I want to be just like her!
records.en_auxiliary: Because there was this really, really cool upperclassman there. I want to be just like her!
records.en: Because there was this really, really cool upperclassman in there.^00I want to be just like her!

records.jp: もー、お姉ちゃんったら遅いんだからー。^00ごめん君、お姉ちゃん見なかった……って^00一年生じゃわかんないか。ごめんね
records.en_original: Hey! I was wondering how long you'd keep me w-- Oh, sorry. Did you see my sister? You're a freshman, huh? Sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey! I was wondering how long you'd keep me w—Oh, sorry. Did you see my sister? You're a freshman, huh? Sorry.
records.en: Jeez, Onee-chan is so late.^00Sorry, have you seen Onee-chan...?^00Oh, you're a first-year, so you wouldn't know. Sorry.

records.jp: もー！　お姉ちゃんったら毎度毎度……！^00いくら私だって、怒るんだからね……！
records.en_original: Ugh! Why is my older sister always, always, always late? I'm really starting to get mad at her!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh! Why is my older sister always, always, always late? I'm really starting to get mad at her!
records.en: Jeez! Onee-chan does this every single time...!^00Even I get angry, you know...!

records.jp: あれ、どうして私待ってるんだろ……。^00お姉ちゃんとはもう一緒に帰らないって^00決めたのに……
records.en_original: Huh? Why am I waiting for her...? I had decided that I would go home alone...
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, why am I waiting for her? I had decided that I would go home alone.
records.en: Huh? Why am I waiting...?^00I decided I wasn't going^00home with Onee-chan anymore...

records.jp: ふふ、早くお姉ちゃん来ないかなー。^00今日はどこに寄ろうかなー♪
records.en_original: Hehe, I hope my sister will be here soon! Where should we go today?♪
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I hope my sister will be here soon! Where should we go today?♪
records.en: Hehe, I hope Onee-chan gets here soon.^00Where should we stop today?♪

records.jp: あー、また呼び出し食らったぁ～。^00二階に上るのめんどくさい～。^00なんで一階に職員室ないのよ～
records.en_original: Ahh, they called me out again. It sucks going up all these stairs... Why is the Teachers' Lounge on the second floor?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, I got called to the teachers' office again. It sucks going up all these stairs. Why is it on the second floor?
records.en: Ahh, they called me out again.^00It sucks going up all these stairs...^00Why is the Teachers' Lounge on the second floor?

records.jp: やばいやばいやばい！^00また遅刻しちゃったよ！^00早く行かないと先輩に叱られる～！
records.en_original: This is terrible! Oh, geez, I'm late again... My upperclassman is going to kill me!
records.en_auxiliary: This is terrible! I'm late again! The older students are going to kill me!
records.en: Oh no, no, no!^00I'm late again!^00I need to hurry or my senpai will scold me!

records.jp: あ、あああ！^00友達との約束、遅刻しちゃうよー！^00いけないいけない、急がないとー！
records.en_original: Ahh! I'm supposed to meet up with my friend, but I'm running late! I have to hurry!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh! I'm supposed to meet up with my friend, but I'm running late! I have to hurry!
records.en: Ahh! I'm supposed to meet up with my friend,^00but I'm running late!^00I have to hurry!

records.jp: 私、時計を新しく買ったんだ。^00自分でも時間にルーズすぎると思って……。^00君も遅刻には気をつけなよ？
records.en_original: I just bought a new watch. I thought it'd help me with my lateness problem. You should learn from my mistakes!
records.en_auxiliary: I just bought a new watch. I thought it'd help me with my lateness problem. You should learn from my mistakes!
records.en: I just bought a new watch.^00I thought it'd help me with my lateness problem.^00You should learn from my mistakes!

records.jp: 明日からはもうちょっと^00真面目にやろうかな
records.en_original: From tomorrow forth, I'm going to be way more serious!
records.en_auxiliary: Starting tomorrow, I'm going to be way more serious!
records.en: Starting tomorrow,^00maybe I'll take things a little more seriously.

records.jp: もう大丈夫。悲しくない。^00ちょっとナーバスな気分になってたのかな
records.en_original: I'm okay now. I'm not sad. I think I was just a little nervous.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm okay now. I'm not sad. I think I was just a little nervous.
records.en: I'm okay now. I'm not sad.^00I think I was just a little nervous.

records.jp: 気持ち……返さないと失礼に^00なっちゃうよね、うん
records.en_original: I feel like...it's probably rude of me not to respond...
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like...it's probably rude of me not to respond.
records.en: I feel like...it's probably^00rude of me not to respond...

records.jp: 謝って許してもらえるかはわからないけど。^00……もう一回、やり直してみることにするよ
records.en_original: I don't know if she'll forgive me, but I'll try to make up to her.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if she'll forgive me, but I'll try to make it up to her.
records.en: I don't know if apologizing will make her forgive me,^00but I'm going to try again.
